Name: Quantum Entangled Chest
Author: GenesisSE
Description:
[size=4][b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ccharon/SDWQuantumChests/refs/heads/master/docs/example.png[/img][/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]you get pairs of quantum entangled chests, they can be placed anywhere and allow access to their shared inventory.[/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]unpack the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder, SMAPI required.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Craft in pairs.[/b] Every crafting recipe produces two chests at once, permanently entangled with each other.[/*]
[*][b]Shared inventory.[/b] Put an item in one chest, it's instantly available in its partner too - regardless of distance or location.[/*]
[*][b]Two tiers.[/b] Quantum Chest (normal capacity) and Big Quantum Chest (70-slot capacity, like a Big Chest).[/*]
[*][b]Color-coded pairs.[/b] Each pair is randomly dyed one of the vanilla chest colors the moment it's crafted, so you can tell pairs apart at a glance even before placing them. Recoloring one chest via the paint-can picker automatically recolors its partner too.[/*]
[*][b]Visually familiar.[/b] Uses the same sprites as a vanilla chest/big chest, so they fit right in - the dye color is what sets a pair apart.[/*]
[*][b]Works with Automate.[/b] Use one or both chests of the pair as storage source for automate.[/*]
[*][b]The danger of quantum mechanics.[/b] Picking up and carrying chests works exactly like vanilla. But if one chest of a pair is ever truly lost for good (not just picked up - genuinely destroyed, trashed, or otherwise made to cease existing), its entangled partner collapses out of existence too, taking the shared contents with it. There's no new way to destroy a chest added by this mod - regular chests are already immune to bombs and can't be broken with tools - but if it ever happens, the entanglement doesn't leave a dangling half behind.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]build and tested with Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2 [/*]
[*]No config options by design.[/*]
[*]Should be safe alongside other mods; uses Harmony patches scoped tightly to its own two item IDs, so it shouldn't affect vanilla items, chests, or other mods' items.[/*]
[/list][url=https://github.com/ccharon/SDWQuantumChests]Github Project[/url]
